# T-301.1: region placement MUST NOT change program meaning. The same
# program runs under logos with the logosarena experiment (what the
# logos driver appends by default) and with arena = false, and both
# runs print the same output for an object placed in a region, for an
# object that escapes to the heap, and for reads after the region
# closes.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/meanon$GOEXE .
stderr 'placed in region'
logos run .
stdout '^17 7 10 12$'
cp stdout $WORK/meanon.txt

cp ../off.toml logos.toml
logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/meanoff$GOEXE .
! stderr 'placed in region'
logos run .
stdout '^17 7 10 12$'
cmp stdout $WORK/meanon.txt

-- off.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/meaning

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/arena"
	"runtime"
)

type node struct {
	v int
}

var escapedNode = &node{}
var escapedSlots []*int

func build(n int) int {
	r := arena.Open()
	head := arena.New[node](r)
	head.v = 7
	escapedNode = head
	slots := make([]*int, 0, n)
	for i := range n {
		v := 10 + i
		slots = append(slots, &v)
	}
	escapedSlots = slots
	s := arena.Make[int](r, 4)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = i + 1
	}
	sum := 0
	for i := range s {
		sum += s[i]
	}
	return sum + head.v
}

func main() {
	sum := build(3)
	runtime.GC()
	first := 0
	if p := escapedSlots[0]; p != nil {
		first = *p
	}
	last := 0
	if p := escapedSlots[len(escapedSlots)-1]; p != nil {
		last = *p
	}
	fmt.Println(sum, escapedNode.v, first, last)
}
